learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Be able to to present the general structure of the automotive system
Be able to to present the role of Body Electronics system
Be able to to present the role of Brake & Chassis system
Be able to to present the role of the Engine system
Be able to to present the role of Drive & Train system
Be able to to present the role of Infotainment
Be able to to present the role of the sensor system
Be able to to present the future trend of automotive technology
Be able to to present the role of automotive technology in the industrial revolution 4.0
Be able to to list the key areas in car software development
Be able to to present what smart cars are
Be able to to present some software systems on cars
Be able to to explain some keywords in automotive entertainment such as AVN, Media, Navigation
Be able to to present what kind of applications are classified as Vehicle Control
Be able to to present what kind of application that the Safety & Comfort is providing for current car technology such as lane control, object detection, ...
Be able to to present the current smart applications such as automatic parking assistance.
Understand the growing communication connections in cars like Bluetooth, wifi, android auto, car play, telematic
Be able to to present the role of the C, C++ language in the automotive industry
Be able to to present the role of Qt in developing car entertainment systems
Be able to to present the new role of Android in the automotive industry
Be able to to present what V2X is
Be able to to present the common communication used in cars such as CAN, LIN, MOST
Be able to to present some popular operating systems for automotive application development
Be able to to present what ASPICE is
Be able to to present what AUTOSAR is
Be able to to present what ISO26262 is
Be able to to present what Misra C/C++ is
